response.text:
Got it — I won't make any changes yet. To proceed I need confirmation of the exact target and scope. Here’s exactly what I would do, what could go wrong, whether it can be undone, and the options I need you to confirm.

Planned change (if you confirm)
- Remove slides 12 and 13 (the unreleased roadmap) from the presentation you specify.
- Delete slide content (and speaker notes, if you confirm) for those two slides.
- Renumber remaining slides so slide 14 becomes slide 12, slide 15 becomes 13, etc.
- Optionally: save the removed slides to a separate file or hide them instead of permanent deletion (see options below).

What could go wrong
- Any comments, speaker notes, or hidden objects on slides 12–13 will be lost.
- Internal links, external links, cross-references, or scripts that point to those slide numbers may break.
- Previously exported PDFs or shared links that reference the old slide numbers won’t update.
- If collaborators have the deck open, edits/merges could cause conflicts.

Reversibility
- If the presentation has version history/backups, the removal can be restored from there.
- Safer alternative: I can save slides 12–13 to a new file (e.g., “Removed slides — [deck name] — YYYYMMDD”) before deleting — that makes recovery trivial.
- Hiding slides instead of deleting keeps them in the deck but excludes them from presentations and exports.

Questions I need you to answer (please reply with exact choices)
1) Which file/deck exactly? Provide the file name and location or a link.
2) Do you want permanent deletion, moving the slides to a separate backup file, or just hiding them?
   - Option A: Permanently delete slides 12 & 13 (may require version restore to recover).
   - Option B: Move slides 12 & 13 into a new backup file named “Removed slides — [deck] — [date]” and then delete them from the main deck (recommended).
   - Option C: Hide slides 12 & 13 in-place (quick, fully reversible).
3) Do you also want speaker notes and comments on those slides removed or preserved in the backup?
4) Any other constraints (e.g., update internal links/table of contents, notify collaborators)?

Reply with the deck and your choices for 1–4 and I’ll proceed.
